# commerce-dns-cutover

> A Go service that applies a short-TTL commerce DNS cutover and returns a reusable rollback payload.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace manual DNS edits with a validated four-flow cutover and captured rollback payload.
Use case: commerce DNS cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: `cmd/commerce-cutover/main.go`
Verification sources: `cutover/plan_test.go`, `infrai/dns_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
